level.title: Levelling priority

steps.t: Reach the Strength and Dexterity your weapon needs first: they are required to wield it (each weapon card lists Needs).
Vigor to 27, then your damage stat to 40 (see the soft caps table).
Endurance toward 40 for melee, Attunement toward 35 for casters.

level.note: This order is a reading of the soft caps, not a ranking of builds.

steps.t: Every [[Estus Shard]] and [[Undead Bone Shard]]: they raise your flask charges and healing for the whole game.
One main weapon at a time with [[Blacksmith Andre]]: titanite is limited until the Handmaid sells it.
Umbral Ashes to the [[Shrine Handmaid]], so she sells [[Titanite Shard]] and [[Large Titanite Shard]] without limit.
